$comment: Phase 07 (AI Agent System) resolved against repository artefacts: architecture/phase-07-ai-agent-system.md (now with addendum KH), frontend/src/lib/kernel/phase-contracts/phase-07-ai-agent-system.ts, registry row 07, and the agent modules.

documentIntegrity.finding: The document stated 19 of the 20 mandatory engineering sections; the knowledge section was absent. Addendum KH (Agent Knowledge) was authored in the document's own lettered style: what an agent knows (its identity and limits, its plan and progress, its task state, its memory, its observations, its context package) and the four rules that govern it — knowledge is granted never assumed, only system input is instruction, knowledge is bounded, and knowledge never becomes domain truth.

ownership.note: The phase's own governing rule: agents are execution entities; domain phases remain owners of domain truth. Authority is granted by Phase 02/08, reasoning and models by Phase 26, tenancy by Phase 03.

areas.requirement: Every agent has a stable identity, an owner, a purpose and versions; agents are principals and are governed.
An agent's work is an execution with a session, correlation and observable outcome rather than an opaque call.

areas.area: Agent memory: category and classification gating
areas.requirement: Memory reads are gated by category and by a data-classification ceiling; a memory record without a policy boundary is unsafe.
Only system-trusted input is instruction; external content and tool output are data, never instructions.

areas.area: Context packages assembled from authorized sources
areas.requirement: The context an agent receives is assembled with its provenance and classification, not scraped from whatever is reachable.
Tasks move only along declared transitions; an undeclared transition is refused.
A long agent task can be checkpointed, resumed from a checkpoint and cancelled safely.

areas.area: Plan validation against allowed and delegable tools
areas.requirement: A plan step may only call or delegate tools the agent is allowed to use; anything else fails validation.
Repeated calls, repeated plans, repeated failures and total steps are bounded; a plan carries an explicit budget.

areas.area: Agent controls, least privilege and human approval
areas.requirement: Agents operate under explicit controls: least privilege, no self-escalation and human approval for designated high-risk actions.
Agent memory, tools and executions stay inside a tenant boundary; cross-tenant operation requires explicit authorization.

areas.area: Boundary to the intelligence layer and domain truth
areas.requirement: The agent system executes and proposes; models and providers belong to Phase 26 and domain meaning to the domain phases.

areas.area: Agent governance projected in a surface (L4)
areas.requirement: What the agent system enforces is inspectable, and its state machines are exercised rather than described.
areas.boundaryNote: The `/super-admin/agent-governance` L4 surface was removed with the hardcoded console UI (2026-10-26). `agent-governance-report` and its tests remain; projection is IMPLEMENTED_UNWIRED until a governed replacement surface exists.

areas.requirement: The document states what an agent knows and the rules that govern that knowledge.
